decisions.rationale: Test fully set-based execution to minimize gets (f1), alongside moderate bulk configurations and caching variants to establish baseline trade-offs across I/O reduction and session memory.
Test hybrid setups combining SET_BASED loops with selective BULK and LOOKUP_CACHE to uncover low-buffer-get configurations without the high memory penalty of full caching and large bulk arrays.
Combine BULK_50/BULK_500 with selective LOOKUP_CACHE on s1 and s5 to explore low f1 while reducing the PGA memory spike seen in run 10.
Test higher bulk limits on s1 and s5 alongside s4=SET_BASED and lookup caching to find the absolute minimum for f1, and test selective caching to explore low-memory tradeoffs.

Test isolating cache impact without bulk overhead, and explore ROW with LOOKUP_CACHE for s1/s5 alongside s4=SET_BASED to discover lower-memory Pareto candidates that still eliminate repeated SQL lookups.
Evaluate SET_BASED across s1/s4 with s5 caching to isolate cache memory costs, and explore combinations of s1=ROW/BULK with selective cache configurations to find lower memory trade-offs.

Evaluating BULK_500 for s1 with cache and SQL for s5/s6 to test intermediate memory/IO frontiers, plus testing cached s6 without caching s2/s3 to explore lower PGA.
Explores the frontier by combining BULK_5000 in s1 with BULK in s5 without caching s6, and selective cache setups at low memory footprint.
Test caching on s6 combined with s1=SET_BASED, and evaluate single-lookup caching (s2 vs s3) under s1=BULK_50/500 to find intermediate memory/gets trade-offs.
Test s2=LOOKUP_SQL with s3=LOOKUP_CACHE and s6=LOOKUP_CACHE to see if memory stays low like config 49 while drastically reducing f1 via cached s6.
Testing s2=LOOKUP_SQL with s3=LOOKUP_CACHE to explore low-memory tradeoffs around the 5696-5824KB frontier, along with BULK_500 on s1.
Test s2=LOOKUP_SQL, s3=LOOKUP_CACHE with s1=ROW/SET_BASED to discover new Pareto points near the minimal f2 boundary (5696-5824KB).
Evaluating pure ROW/low-bulk baseline variations with selective caching to explore ultra-low f2 memory profiles, and testing BULK_50 combinations with LOOKUP_SQL across sites.
Test s1=BULK_500 with s2=LOOKUP_SQL and s3=LOOKUP_SQL, which could yield low f2 (<5800KB) and competitive f1, plus s1=ROW with cache combinations targeting the low-memory boundary.
Exploit the low-PGA region around config 70 and 54 by testing BULK_5000 on s5 or s4 variations, and explore s1=BULK_5000 with LOOKUP_SQL/LOOKUP_CACHE to uncover memory-buffer tradeoffs.
Combine minimal PGA baselines with selective caching and SET_BASED optimizations, probing low-PGA trade-offs and untapped bulk variations across s1 and s4.
Test s4=SET_BASED with s1=SET_BASED and s6=LOOKUP_CACHE to push f1 lower at moderate memory, plus fine-tuning s1/s5 bulk variants with cache lookups for memory vs I/O trade-offs.
Test BULK_5000 combinations on s1/s5 around the Pareto frontier to balance minimum gets and PGA, probing potential dominates between 24.7k-25.7k gets and around 5.6MB-11.3MB PGA.

Test intermediate combinations between low memory (s2=LOOKUP_SQL, s3=LOOKUP_CACHE) and low I/O with BULK/SET_BASED permutations, specifically checking SET_BASED at s1 or s4/s5 to fill Pareto gaps near the knee.
Test fully set-based execution to minimize gets (f1), alongside moderate bulk configurations and caching variants to map the memory vs. logical I/O trade-off across loops.
